On VTES-L, "Mark Cagnolatti >>" <VampC...@AOL.COM> wrote:
> On games such as malkavian prank that require guessing what is the ruling
> on letting other players know your total pool? Must this be revealed? Is
> it knowable after choosing, but before guessing?

All players' pool levels are always known. Players should keep their
pool in plain site. If not, it must be revealed at any prompting.

> Does a vampire receive blood from the rack while in torpor?

Yes.

> Does a Trap gain more presses if a card like nosferatu putrescence is played
> by a third party?

Yes, the Trap's "counter" is reset whenever any card is played.

> Does Sword of Judgement count against the additional strikes?

Yes. The limit on gaining additional strikes applies to all
additional-strike-gaining effects.

> Is there any way for a torpored vampire to take damage?

Yes. Untapping while Charnas is on him, for instance.
Once at zero blood, however, the damage is ignored (unless
aggravated damage is somehow done).

> What's the deal with March Halcyon and Amaranth as opposed to straight up
> Diablerie?

No deal. The diablerizing vampire cannot have a Blood Hunt called on
him if he was the acting vampire (as opposed to blocking March).

> I only caught the tail end of the discussion on propaganda - Is it true that
> it can tap a tapped minion or do my ears decieve me with a decision that cuts
> the legs off that card entirely?

It's true. It's before the RT for re-reversal.
